mapper.select: SELECT STM.id AS stockTypeId, STM.name AS stockTypeName FROM stock_type_master STM WHERE 1 = 1 AND STM.del = FALSE ORDER BY STM.stock_type , STM.stock_code
SELECT SM.staff_no AS staffNo, SM.name AS staffName FROM staff_master SM WHERE 1 = 1 /* 棚卸のため削除フラグを考慮しない */ ORDER BY SM.staff_no
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_data SET confirmed_date = STR_TO_DATE( #{inventoryDate}, '%Y/%m/%d') WHERE id = #{stockDataId}
mapper.select: SELECT EDV.シリアルナンバー AS serialNo, EDV.使用者 AS staffName, EDV.貸出可否 AS rentFlg, -- 貸出可否の文字列が設定されている想定 EDV.貸出開始日 AS startDate, EDV.返却予定日 AS limitDate, EDV.最終所在確認日 AS confirmedDate, EDV.製品名 AS model, EDV.メーカー AS maker, EDV.接続先PCシリアルナンバー AS destinationSerialNo, EDV.分類 AS type, EDV.リース返却予定日 AS leaseDate, EDV.備考 AS remarks, EDV.stock_type, EDV.stock_code, EDV.備品データID AS stockDataId, EDV.社員番号 AS staff_no FROM equip_detail_view EDV WHERE 1 = 1 AND EDV.stock_type = #{type} AND EDV.stock_code = #{code} ORDER BY EDV.シリアルナンバー
